sources.publisher: Daniel Grund and Sebastian Hack (solution set hosted on the challenge page)
sources.description: Integer-linear-programming solutions of all 474 instances with CPLEX logs and the challenge checker's cost output (.asl, .log, .chk); instances 139, 304 and 387 are marked feasible, not proven optimal

sources.publisher: Andrew W. Appel and Lal George (solution set hosted on the challenge page)
sources.description: Solutions of the 474 instances by a greedy algorithm based on iterated register coalescing

sources.publisher: Andrew W. Appel and Lal George (solution set hosted on the challenge page)
sources.description: Solutions of the 474 instances by a variant of the optimistic coalescing algorithm of Park and Moon
